snp5.3:3.2: AN 6:61 records several elders debating what “both sides” and “in between” mean in this verse, offering six different readings: (a) contact / the arising of contact / the ceasing of contact; (b) past / future / present; (c) pleasant feeling / painful feeling / neither-pleasant-nor-painful feeling; (d) name (mental phenomena) / form (physical phenomena) / consciousness; (e) the six internal sense media / the six external sense media / consciousness; (f) self-identity / the arising of self-identity / the ceasing of self-identity. When the elders bring the question to the Buddha, he says all six are well put, but that the first — contact — was the one he had in mind. On the ceasing of contact, see also SN 35:117.
snp5.3:3.4: The same figure of craving as a seamstress recurs at Thag 14:2.
